title: Cave B humidity readings lost overnight
description: The Cave B IoT gateway stopped forwarding sensor data. CaveGuard showed stale values for five hours and raised no alert, so the night shift did not check the Brie cave.
review:
## Summary
CAVE-GW-02 froze after a firmware watchdog failure. CaveGuard kept the last readings on screen and did not flag the missing data.

## Impact
- 18 sensors of Cave B without data from 01:20 to 06:45.
- Two Brie batches checked by hand at 07:00: humidity had dropped to 82%, within tolerance.

## Root cause
The gateway firmware had no automatic restart on watchdog failure.

## Actions
- Firmware updated on both cave gateways (done).
- CaveGuard now alerts when a sensor sends nothing for 15 minutes (done).
- Add the gateways to PRTG monitoring (open).

title: Phishing campaign against accounts payable
description: Fake supplier invoices with a link to a cloned Microsoft sign-in page reached 23 people in Finance. One user entered a password; Okta blocked the sign-in at the MFA step.

title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
description: Financial close jobs ran four times slower than usual. PAR-ESX-01 was overcommitted after a host maintenance, with the S/4HANA and BW servers on the same host.

title: B2B portal down: database disk full
description: Distributors could not place orders for three hours. The PostgreSQL 13 server of the B2B portal filled its disk with write-ahead logs after the archive job failed.
review:
## Summary
The WAL archive job on PAR-DB-01 had been failing for six days. The disk filled at 07:50 and PostgreSQL stopped accepting writes.

## Impact
- Fromage B2B Portal unavailable from 07:50 to 11:10.
- About 140 orders taken by phone and keyed in afterwards.

## Root cause
The archive target changed during the SAN migration and nobody watched the job.

## Actions
- Archive job fixed and monitored (done).
- Disk usage alert at 80% on database servers (done).
- Upgrade PostgreSQL 13, out of support, as part of the portal roadmap (open).

title: Order confirmations sent to the wrong customers
description: A caching bug in the online shop release sent 214 order confirmation emails with another customer name, address and order content.
notified_parties: CNIL; 214 affected customers informed by email on 10 July

title: Veeam backup jobs failing on the backup SAN
description: Three nights of failed backup jobs after two disk failures on PAR-SAN-02. The array reaches end of life in December 2026 and no spare disks are left under support.

title: CheeseTrack offline during SQL Server cluster failover
description: Patching PAR-SQL-02 triggered a failover that CheeseTrack did not follow: its connection string named the node, not the listener. Cold chain scans were queued on the handhelds and synced afterwards.

title: Microsoft Teams outage in Western Europe
description: Microsoft service incident: meetings and chat unavailable for most users for close to three hours. No action on our side beyond informing users.

title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
description: The embedded SQL Server 2017 Express database reached its 10 GB limit. Results are recorded on paper until the database moves to the SQL Server cluster.

title: VPN to the Gouda site keeps dropping
description: The site-to-site VPN between GOU-FW-01 and Paris renegotiates every few minutes since Sunday. Dutch users find Sage X3 slow and lose their sessions.
